verses.text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.

segments.text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God:
Set me on high from them that rise up against me.

verses.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.

segments.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity,
And save me from the bloodthirsty men.

verses.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

segments.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul;
The mighty gather themselves together against me:
Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

verses.text: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.

verses.text: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. [Selah

segments.text: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel,

verses.text: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

segments.text: They return at evening, they howl like a dog,
And go round about the city.

verses.text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, say they, doth hear?

segments.text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth;

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

segments.text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them;
Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

verses.text: Because of his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.

segments.text: Because of
his strength I will give heed unto thee;

verses.text: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

segments.text: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me:

verses.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

segments.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget:
Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down,

verses.text: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.text: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth. [Selah

verses.text: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

segments.text: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog,

verses.text: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.

segments.text: They shall wander up and down for food,

verses.text: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.

verses.text: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
